prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC089 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached 2x2 image as the exact portrait identity, fearful emotion, muted palette, asymmetric spacing, eye-opening shape, and blink-phase reference. Preserve this NPC's own hair/head silhouette, muted tan-brown skin, compact gray-violet iris clusters, dark pupils and outlines, and worried fearful brows. Keep the same pixel scale and low-resolution sprite rendering.

Canvas: one seamless two-column by two-row sheet, without margin, gutters, labels, extra faces, text, or decoration. Preserve the reference canvas ratio 1024:560 and cell ratio 64:35. Cell order: top-left open eyes looking LEFT; top-right open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right half-blink eyes looking RIGHT.

Preserve the exact source open and half-blink upper/lower lid contours, aperture width/height, eye angle, asymmetric spacing, compact stepped iris size, and brow shape in every pose. The only difference between left and right is a gentle roughly one-native-pixel horizontal shift of each compact, stepped gray-violet iris/pupil cluster within its existing aperture. Retain the actual muted gray-violet hue and dark pupil/outline from the reference. Keep the half-blink gaze aligned with the open pose above. Do not widen eye openings or expose extra pale sclera; keep sclera muted warm beige and no broader than source. Keep highlights tiny, dim, and consistent with the existing pixels; no bright flashes or white bands. Avoid large/square irises, pupils crossing lids, changing either brow/expression, facial symmetry correction, smoothing, antialiasing, blur, or any added content.
